name: RfcTerminalCascade
capture: load triggering RFC/current terminal epoch/status evidence and exact current hierarchy inside one UnitOfWork
derive exact_rfc or root_branch scope without recursion beyond the accepted two levels
capture RFC identities, revisions and derived roles in deterministic order

ask RfcTerminalTaskParticipant for applicable active nonterminal WFM identities/revisions/task_nos for exactly those RFC identities, then validate/normalize them into the deterministic WFM order defined by SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1
compute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 over proposal contract version, trigger/scope identity, terminal epoch/status evidence, ordered RFC members and ordered WFM members
insert pending proposal and immutable member rows in the same transaction as terminal-status acceptance

preview.output: persisted proposal plus comparison against current RFC hierarchy/revisions, current terminal epoch/evidence, current applicable WFM membership, Task/Objective impact preview and Communication consequence preview; READY output includes RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 containing only the complete provider count/fingerprint summaries plus preview_fingerprint
preview.rule: preview never mutates or refreshes scope and never counts as deliberate confirmation

refresh_stale_pending: only a still-current terminal epoch with a pending stale proposal is refreshable; staleness includes a terminal Closed<->Cancelled correction that preserved the epoch but changed current terminal status class/evidence
capture a new exact scope using SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1
inside one UnitOfWork supersede the old pending proposal with command/time provenance and insert the replacement pending proposal/member rows
do not execute downstream consequences during refresh
execute: resolve exact command replay before owner preparation, current-state reads or deliberate-proof validation; replay returns the original persisted execution result without revalidating or consuming a proof again
require an RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 emitted by a READY preview; scope_fingerprint alone is not an execute input or sufficient reviewed authority

inside one writer UnitOfWork load the exact pending proposal/revision and verify triggering RFC is still in the same terminal epoch with the exact same current terminal status class/evidence captured by the proposal

recompute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 from exact current RFC hierarchy/revisions and current applicable WFM membership; any material mismatch returns RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE with no proof consumption or mutation

ask RfcTerminalTaskParticipant.revalidate_terminal_cascade in the same UnitOfWork to recompute its complete current Task/Objective impact authority and exact-compare both reviewed exact_count and provider_fingerprint; STALE aborts as RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_STALE and INDETERMINATE fails closed as RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_FAILED
ask RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant.revalidate_terminal_cascade under the identical contract for the complete current Communication impact authority

after both providers return READY reconstruct exact SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 using current proposal/scope facts, empty stale reasons and the reviewed provider summaries now certified equal to current authority; require the digest equals execution_review.preview_fingerprint

only after all freshness checks pass validate_and_consume the LLD-12 deliberate proof for action tickets.rfc.terminal_cascade.execute, exact DeliberateActionTargetV1 proposal target, base proposal revision and execution_review.preview_fingerprint; proof is friction evidence, not business authorization
insert the single command receipt before participant-owned mutation rows can reference command_id
invoke RfcTerminalTaskParticipant.apply_terminal_cascade using the same UnitOfWork; it owns WFM/Task/Objective consequences and returns immutable result references

invoke RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant.apply_terminal_cascade using the same UnitOfWork; it owns RFC Communication unlink/frozen-summary/orphan-grace consequences and returns immutable result references

if any required apply participant fails, roll back the whole database transaction and leave proposal pending; the already-consumed LLD-12 proof remains single-use and a retry requires a fresh deliberate action
transition proposal to executed, append minimal audit/result references including reviewed preview_fingerprint, persist exact response and commit all participant mutations atomically
rules: safe auto-accept/import acceptance can create a pending proposal only when terminal evidence itself is explicitly accepted under its allowed review policy; it can never execute the cascade
the committed Task/Objective and Communication consequences must equal the complete provider consequences reviewed in the bound preview; unchanged RFC/WFM scope alone is insufficient
participant revalidation returns no impact rows and copies no provider-owned state into LLD-03; each provider remains the sole authority for its complete impact calculation
SR lifecycle and unrelated Local Tasks are outside cascade scope
provider WFM status evidence is preserved; LLD-05 appends local termination provenance rather than rewriting provider facts
surviving executable Objective work and loss-of-last-executable-Task behavior are exclusively enforced by LLD-05 participant contract
executed proposal is immutable history; erroneous cascade is corrected by later governed append/correction flows rather than editing execution evidence

terminal-to-terminal source correction preserves the terminal epoch and existing proposal history but does not silently retarget a pending proposal to different status evidence; the old proposal becomes stale for execution until explicit refresh

scope_fingerprint.purpose: Exact deterministic freshness token for terminal-cascade proposal capture, persisted-scope preview comparison, refresh and writer-time current RFC/WFM scope revalidation. It binds only authoritative cascade scope/evidence, not downstream provider impact authority; therefore it is never sufficient by itself to bind deliberate execution.
scope_fingerprint.canonical_object: Build the exact closed object {schema:'SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1',proposal_contract_version:1,trigger_rfc_id,terminal_epoch_id,terminal_status_class,terminal_status_evidence_id,scope_kind,rfc_members:[{rfc_id,captured_rfc_revision,captured_role},...],wfm_members:[{task_id,owning_rfc_id,captured_task_revision,captured_task_no},...]}; no extra keys are permitted.
field_validation: trigger_rfc_id and every RFC/task identity are exact validated immutable owner identities
terminal_epoch_id and terminal_status_evidence_id are non-empty exact current accepted evidence identities
captured RFC/Task revisions are positive integers; booleans are not integers for this contract
captured_role is standalone, root or subordinate and must agree with the exact captured hierarchy
captured_task_no is the exact immutable LLD-05 WFM Task No. matching TK plus fourteen ASCII digits
RFC and WFM member identities are unique and each WFM owning_rfc_id is present in rfc_members
scope_derivation: if trigger is subordinate: scope_kind=exact_rfc and rfc_members contains exactly the trigger with captured_role=subordinate
if trigger is parentless standalone: scope_kind=root_branch and rfc_members contains exactly the trigger with captured_role=standalone
if trigger is parentless root/master: scope_kind=root_branch; ordinal/member order is trigger root first with captured_role=root followed by every active direct child with captured_role=subordinate

ordering.rfc_members: trigger/root entry first; for root_branch with children, remaining subordinate entries sort by rfc_id UTF-8 bytes ascending. exact_rfc has one member.
ordering.wfm_members: sort by owning_rfc_id UTF-8 bytes ascending, then task_id UTF-8 bytes ascending. The LLD-03 owner validates participant output and applies this order before hashing/persistence; participant iteration order is never authority.
ordering.ordinal_rule: persisted membership ordinal is exactly the zero-based array position after canonical ordering. Ordinal is therefore excluded from each member object to avoid duplicating the same authority twice.

scope_fingerprint.canonicalization: Serialize the exact closed object with LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exactly: ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), then UTF-8 encode. Hash lowercase SHA-256 over those exact bytes.
scope_fingerprint.versioning_rule: Any change to included keys, member semantics, ordering or canonicalization requires a new profile name and proposal_contract_version; existing persisted proposal fingerprints are never reinterpreted under a later profile.
exclusions: proposal_id, proposal_state, proposal revision and proposal creation/execution/supersession timestamps or command IDs
membership ordinal because canonical array position already binds order
RFC business number, source/display fields, warnings, Customer, archive state, SR/device/note counts and unrelated revisions not named in the canonical object
Task/Objective/Communication preview impact text or derived consequence counts/fingerprints; these are separately bound by SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PREVIEW_V1 and RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1
transport cursor/page boundaries, physical row order and participant iteration order

golden_vectors.rule: Exact-subordinate scope with no applicable WFM proves exact_rfc role/scope binding and empty membership canonicalization.
Root branch with two children/two WFMs proves root-first child ordering, WFM owner/task ordering, role/revision participation and terminal evidence participation.

performance: capture and revalidation use indexed two-level RFC queries plus bounded participant membership/impact reads; no recursive graph traversal or unbounded in-transaction workbook processing is permitted. Complete hash input is bounded by current RFC/WFM and provider-owned terminal-impact authority and should be streamed or otherwise constructed without unrelated domain expansion.
